description: This file defines a React functional component named FocusModeSwitch that provides a toggle switch for focus mode functionality within a web application. It handles user interactions, keyboard shortcuts, and mobile detection to conditionally render UI elements.

classes.name: FocusModeSwitch
classes.description: React functional component for toggling focus mode in the UI.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Handles the toggle action for focus mode, calling onToggle and onClose callbacks.

methods.name: useCallback
methods.description: React hook to memoize the toggle function.

methods.name: useMemo
methods.description: React hook to memoize the keyboard shortcut retrieval.
